LABEL: PROXY_NOT_SETTLEMENT_INDEX
what_this_is_not: This is NOT the index Polymarket settles its BTC up-down markets against. That index is unavailable to this study: the Zenodo archive carries no strike, no reference price and no settlement index. Any feature derived here is a proxy from a DIFFERENT venue's spot market and is labelled as such. Distance-from-strike is NOT derivable and is not derived.
